1.explanation:
• src/js/components/Form/README.md – explains the Form API, validation triggers, and onValidate behavior.
• src/js/components/FormField/README.md – details how FormField manages individual field validation (including required).  
• src/js/components/TextInput/README.md – shows how TextInput integrates with FormField and handles value changes.  
• src/js/components/CheckBox/README.md – covers the CheckBox component used to toggle the field’s presence.  
• src/js/components/Form/stories/typescript – contains TS examples of dynamic forms/fields, useful to see a working pattern.  
• src/js/components/Form/stories/CustomThemed – offers themed Form examples, which may include dynamic add/remove of fields, helping reproduce and compare behavior.
1.bug_scenario: In the provided GIF and CodeSandbox, a Form contains a CheckBox labeled “have alias?”. When you check the box, a required TextInput (“Alias”) is dynamically inserted into the form. The form’s onValidate callback correctly reports invalid when this new field has no value. However, when you uncheck the box and the TextInput is removed, onValidate still reports the form as invalid—even though there are no remaining required fields left empty. In other words, the form doesn’t clear out its previous validation state when a required field is dynamically removed.
